activities.anchor: The method mattered more than the slogan
activities.caption: pair each habit with its historiographer
activities.name: histRankeMatch

config.prompt: The empirical revolution — pair each habit with its origin:

pairs.right: students trained on source criticism like laboratory scientists
the chronicle that omits a famine tells you what the monastery wanted remembered — the omission is evidence too
even the most scrupulous historian writes from a time and place
the hidden assumption the promise concealed — every charter and letter was written by someone, for someone

config.why: Work from original documents over secondary accounts, interrogate provenance and bias, and let the archive decide — the discipline's baseline discipline.

activities.anchor: forgeries, flattery, selective memory, genre conventions
activities.caption: true or false — the source speaks?
activities.name: histSourceJudge

statements.s: A primary source is an artefact produced by an author with an audience and an aim.
statements.why: Which is why the 'facts' arrive pre-selected.

statements.s: Two honest historians can hold the same document and report different facts from it.
statements.why: Because 'what it says' already involves interpretation.

statements.s: Source criticism exists because sources sometimes flatter but never actually mislead.
statements.why: Forgeries, flattery, selective memory and genre conventions mislead constantly — the skill exists precisely because they do.

activities.caption: drag the divider — the transition debate
activities.name: histTransitionCompare

config.prompt: How did feudalism become capitalism? Two answers, decades of argument — drag the divider:

before.label: Dobb — from within
before.text: Internal class relations did it: lords and tenants, landlords and labourers — the feudal structure broke from its own contradictions.

after.label: Sweezy — from outside
after.text: Trade did it: exchange, markets and the pull of commerce dissolved the feudal order from beyond the manor gate.

config.why: A single 'when did X begin' question can expose an entire theory of history — which is what the argument, running from the 1950s, taught a generation.

activities.caption: line up the Annales shelf, by year
activities.name: histAnnalesOrder

config.prompt: History from the depths — order these by year, earliest first:
items: The journal Annales d'histoire économique et sociale founded — 1929
The Mediterranean and the Mediterranean World — 1949
Montaillou, a Pyrenean village rebuilt from an inquisitor's register — 1975
The Cheese and the Worms, a miller's cosmology — 1976
config.why: From the journal that re-proportioned the discipline to microhistories proving even the illiterate majority — the people the archives recorded only when they came before a court — had worlds worth reconstructing. Marc Bloch, executed by the Gestapo in June 1944, carries the school's memorial.

activities.caption: pair each widening of the cast with its scholar
activities.name: histBelowMatch

config.prompt: History from below — pair each widening with who widened it:

pairs.right: the artisans and labourers who made themselves into a class
the peasants of India, whose revolts appeared in British records only as disorder to be suppressed
gender as a category of historical analysis
ask who the prevailing story left out, find the new sources, and treat the absence as a historical fact

config.why: Rankean rigour was never abandoned — its object expanded from states to societies.

activities.anchor: watch one question refuse to settle
activities.caption: file each artefact under its never-ending debate
activities.name: histDebatesBuckets

config.prompt: Three arguments that never ended — file each piece of evidence:

items.label: Article 231 wrote German war guilt into the Versailles settlement
a West German political scandal detonated in 1961
Gibbon's grand narrative of decay and barbarian catastrophe
climate proxies and plague pits shifting the balance
Time on the Cross (1974) calling slave plantations efficient

config.why: Each generation found, in the same documents, the war its own century needed — and a number, Fogel proved, is also an argument.

activities.caption: bet before you read on — the r-word
activities.name: histRevisionPredict

choices: Yes — revisionists rewrite the record to suit politics
No — revision is the discipline's engine; the legitimate worry is relativism, not revision
Only when the archives are closed
config.why: The pejorative belongs to politics, not method: Fischer's case against Germany was revisionism and correct scholarship even where it was overclaiming.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — the history-wars briefing
activities.name: histMemorySpot

config.prompt: One line of this history-wars briefing is wrong — click it:
lines: Pierre Nora's lieux de mémoire project opened the study of how nations remember.
Commemoration, monuments and anniversaries compete with scholarly history.
The history wars over curricula, museums and statues are historiography running in public.
They are arguments about which past a society owes itself.
They will be settled once enough documents are digitised.
config.correction: They will not be settled by more documents alone — they are arguments about values wearing documents as armour.
config.why: That is what makes the history wars historiography running in public: the discipline's arguments, conducted with monuments instead of monographs.
